statements.markdown: **Theorem 3.1 (a summable divisor-cover criterion).** *For each $j\ge1$, let $F_j\subseteq\mathbb{N}_{>0}$ be finite, let $0<\alpha_j\le1$, and let $c_{j,d}\ge0$ satisfy* $$ f_{F_j}(n)^{\alpha_j}\le\sum_{d\mid n}c_{j,d}\quad(n\ge1). $$ *Set $C_j=\sum_{d\ge1}c_{j,d}/d$. If* $$ \sum_{j\ge1}\frac{C_j2^{j\alpha_j}}{2^{\alpha_j}-1}<\infty, \tag{V} $$ *then $X_A(b)$ is irrational for every infinite $A\subseteq\bigcup_jF_j$ and every integer $b\ge2$.*
